author: Good Enough
description:
If a python attacks you, the wrong reaction could make the situation far more dangerous.

Pythons are powerful constrictors capable of overpowering prey by wrapping around them and cutting off movement and breathing. This video explains what to do during a python attack, the mistakes that can make things worse, and how to improve your chances of escaping safely.

This Short breaks down survival tips for one of the most dangerous snake encounters in the wild.
